main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a character color model (色指定). Defines per-character palette × lighting-condition mapping used by the finisher actor for automatic color tracing. Status=approved triggers `colorModel-ready-autoTrace` derive rule against all keyframes of matching characters.

lightingCondition.description: Color set is per lighting condition. Multiple colorModel records per character allowed (one per condition).

palette.description: Color stops for each body part / material.

materialMap.description: Blob CID of the material index image (each pixel = material ID, used by AI segmentation).

refSheetCid.description: Blob CID of the painted reference sheet.

part.description: Body part / material name (hair / skin / eye / clothing.primary / clothing.shadow1 ...).
